name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After § 52 – Am 36
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 52a. Expresses concern that the Agreement does not adequately address the risk of imports produced using pesticides banned in the EU; stresses that this creates unfair competition for EU farmers and raises serious environmental and public health concerns; calls on the Commission to ensure strict reciprocity of standards and to address this issue through binding provisions and effective controls;
